hook.name: IncineratorHook
hook.description: Applies a 1.2% fee on all swaps: buy fees collect as ETH in a burn pot; sell fees queue as tokens for burning. Every 20 swaps a buyback is queued (BuybackQueued event); the ETH buyback-and-burn is executed by a later buyAndBurn() call (a nested pool swap). Sells are blocked in the same block as a buyback. Sells can also be gated to a deployer-managed allowlist (via tx.origin) in afterSwap: any address can permissionlessly trigger this per token, after which only allowlisted addresses can sell.
